description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Haliela, Biyagama and Polgahawela D/S Divisions for Water Projects
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties and servitude rights for water treatment plant construction and access roads. The document provides detailed descriptions of land parcels, including their locations, boundaries, extents, and claimant information. While it mentions a government minister (Rauff Hakeem) exercising statutory powers, the core content focuses entirely on land/property acquisition rather than government personnel changes or structural reforms, making it a Land Gazette.
